# 無界啟程 BOOUNDLESS

> A Traditional Chinese vehicle-management application with CarAI assistance.

## Public website
- [Home](https://booundless.vercel.app/): Vehicle management, maintenance reminders, and journey planning.

## Scope
Account, vehicle, dealer, and administrative views are application screens, not public reference material. Do not treat demonstration vehicles as user data or verified specifications. AI suggestions require confirmation and are not a substitute for professional vehicle inspection.

This file describes the site; it does not grant access to private data or authenticated APIs.
